title: Controlled Evaluation of EEG Foundation Models: Random Initialisation, Band-Power and Validation-Selected Probes
abstract: arXiv:2610.32067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: EEG foundation models report downstream gains, yet their protocols seldom include three controls. These are the same encoder untrained, spectral features fitted on the same data, and a layer picked without looking at test scores. We therefore evaluate five publicly released EEG foundation models and an in-house JEPA-style model under one protocol with all three controls and several seeds, on five benchmarks and four added task families. The controls change the reading in three ways. First, picking the probed layer by its test score raises the layer-wise peak by an average of +0.034 and reverses the peak-versus-output gap in 9 of 36 cells. Second, with the layer picked on validation, random initialisation matches or beats pretraining for half of the models on sleep and emotion, and no model beats a five-band log-power baseline on emotion or motor imagery. translated_title: EEG基础模型的受控评估：随机初始化、频带功率与基于验证集选择的探测层
translated_abstract: EEG基础模型报告了下游任务的性能提升，但其评估协议很少包含三种对照：即同一编码器未经训练的版本、在同一数据上拟合的频谱特征，以及不看测试分数而选择的层。因此，我们在统一协议下、采用全部三种对照和多个随机种子，在五个基准和四个附加任务族上评估了五个公开发布的EEG基础模型和一个自研的JEPA风格模型。这些对照从三个方面改变了评估结论。第一，若按测试分数选择探测层，逐层峰值平均提高+0.034，并在36个单元格中的9个里逆转了峰值与输出之间的差距。第二，当在验证集上选择层时，随机初始化在睡眠和情绪任务上与预训练持平甚至更优（涉及一半的模型），且没有任何模型在情绪或运动想象任务上胜过五频带对数功率基线。第三，在完全微调后，30对实验中仅有5对的增益超过其随机种子波动范围的2倍……
tldr: 该论文通过引入未训练编码器、频带功率基线和基于验证集的层选择三种对照，对多个EEG基础模型进行受控评估，发现其预训练收益大多不具统计稳健性，随机初始化和简单的频带功率基线即可与之匹敌。
en_tdlr: A controlled evaluation of EEG foundation models using random initialisation, band-power baselines, and validation-selected probe layers reveals that most reported pretraining gains are not robust, with random initialisation matching half the models and simple spectral baselines remaining competitive.
